subject: Coding "no observations" in Distance package in R

messages.author: 0904ff57d7c62ff7
messages.subject: Coding "no observations" in Distance package in R
parts:
Hi,

I am using the Distance package in R for the first time, having used the Distance software before. How do I code the case of "no observation" for a transect? I tried including a line in my data frame for the effort, with an NA or "." for the distance, but received a message about missing values and NaN's not being allowed.

Any guidance would be much welcomed. (I tried to look through past postings, but didn't see this question. Apologies if this is a double posting.)

Thanks,
John

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: RE: [distance-sampling] Coding "no observations" in Distance package in R
parts:
John:

Have a look at sample data file "minke.csv" that can be found at http://distancesampling.org/R/vignettes/minke.csv. That will give you an example with transects 5 and 6 of the "South" stratum where there was effort but no detections.

Hope that is helpful, ask for further clarification if that doesn't get the job done for you.
